economic_rationale: The trade is useful only if broad positive funding receipts exceed spot and perpetual execution costs under normal and stressed assumptions while conservative futures collateral remains far from liquidation. Equal BTC quantities remove most directional exposure, but basis path, negative funding episodes and quarterly turnover remain explicit risks.
mechanism: Allocate 25 percent of equity to long BTC spot and retain 75 percent as collateral for an equal-quantity short Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual. A short receives positive signed funding calculated from the official mark-price open and frozen funding rate. Close and reopen only at quarter-start 01:00 UTC after the 00:00 funding event, then fully liquidate at each evaluation boundary.
thesis: A quarterly reset 25-percent-spot and 75-percent-futures-collateral BTCUSDT delta-neutral carry policy earns positive after-cost returns with low drawdown because broadly positive perpetual funding exceeds execution costs and basis-path losses in both Design and historical Validation.
title: Binance BTCUSDT quarterly delta-neutral funding carry
